propositions: Authors must understand that risky runtime mechanisms require fast out-of-loop proof (local run or manual probe) before committing to slow codified delivery loops such as CI/CD, IaC apply, or provisioning.
The packaged guide for plan writing must identify and explain the de-risk-before-slow-loop behavior as criterion T15, with stack-agnostic mechanism class language.
Throwaway experiments must include scoped teardown that limits cleanup to only resources created by the experiment.
Documentation and registry module docstring must reflect the validated 44 criteria in T1–T15 range, replacing stale T1–T12 enumeration.
Generated criterion-pins.json must be regenerated via guide_parity tool to include the new T15 pin.
The rebar explain plan command output must render T15 guidance including slow-loop naming, local-or-manual proof forms, and scoped-cleanup boundaries.
